properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 6:15AM CDT until August 9 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
SVRDMX

The National Weather Service in Des Moines has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southern Kossuth County in north central Iowa...
Northwestern Hancock County in north central Iowa...

* Until 700 AM CDT.

* At 614 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Sexton, or 5
miles northeast of Algona, moving northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Algona, Titonka, Wesley, St. Benedict, Irvington, Sexton, Hutchins,
Algona Municipal Airport, and Aa Call State Park.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 6:14AM CDT by NWS Twin Cities/Chanhassen MN
properties.description:
At 614 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from near Good Thunder to 11 miles south of
Elmore, or extending from 15 miles south of Mankato to 29 miles
southeast of Fairmont, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible.

Locations impacted include...
Blue Earth, Wells, Mapleton, Minnesota Lake, Elmore, Good Thunder,
Amboy, Bricelyn, Vernon Center, Pemberton, Waldorf, Easton, Frost,
Delavan, Kiester, Brush Creek, Walters, Baroda and Alma City.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 6:04AM CDT until August 9 at 6:45AM CDT by NWS La Crosse WI
properties.description:
SVRARX

The National Weather Service in La Crosse has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Buffalo County in west central Wisconsin...
Northeastern Trempealeau County in west central Wisconsin...

* Until 645 AM CDT.

* At 604 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Mondovi,
moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and half dollar size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Strum around 615 AM CDT.
Osseo around 630 AM CDT.

Other locations impacted by this severe thunderstorm include Chimney
Rock, Highway 53 And County E, Mondovi Airfield, Eleva,
Pleasantville, and Pigeon Falls.

This includes Interstate 94 between mile markers 88 and 91.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 5:56AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
At 556 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles east of Iowa Lake, or 13 miles southeast of Fairmont, moving
northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor hail damage to vegetation is possible.

Locations impacted include...
Iowa Lake, Swea City, Lakota, and Ledyard.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 9 at 5:48AM CDT until August 9 at 12:00PM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
FFWDMX

The National Weather Service in Des Moines has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Webster County in central Iowa...

* Until noon CDT Sunday.

* At 548 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 4 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as
other poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Western portions of Fort Dodge, Lizard Creek, and Clare.
properties.instruction:
For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 5:38AM CDT by NWS Twin Cities/Chanhassen MN
properties.description:
At 538 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from over Arlington to near Springfield, or
extending from 23 miles southeast of Hutchinson to 20 miles southeast
of Redwood Falls, moving east at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible.

Locations impacted include...
New Ulm, St. Peter, New Prague, Belle Plaine, Le Sueur, Sleepy Eye,
Le Center, Gaylord, Arlington, Winthrop, Nicollet, Henderson,
Gibbon, Kasota, Courtland, Green Isle, Lafayette, Cleveland and
Helena.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.
